# Vendored frontend assets

These files are served locally; there are no runtime CDN requests.

| Component | Version | Download source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap CSS | 5.3.3 | jsDelivr npm/bootstrap |
| Chart.js UMD | 4.4.8 | jsDelivr npm/chart.js |
| Cytoscape.js | 3.31.0 | jsDelivr npm/cytoscape |
| vis-timeline standalone and CSS | 7.7.3 | jsDelivr npm/vis-timeline |

Upstream copyright/license headers remain in the distributed files. The pinned download paths are recorded in scripts/vendor_assets.py. Review component licenses before distributing modified assets. No source map is required for runtime use.
